Inserted a short insurance covenant as new General Provisions subsection (l) after p0159 at the playbook preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request), with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback flagged in the comment.
